name: serpapi_google_local
description: Find Google Local business listings through SerpApi. Use for phrases such as 'near me', 'nearby restaurants', 'local coffee shops', 'businesses around here', 'find a plumber near me', or Google local results for a supplied topic. Returns ratings, reviews, prices, hours, addresses, business types, descriptions, service options, action links, coordinates, sponsored listings, related place searches, and pagination. When location is omitted, it uses JARVIS_DEFAULT_LOCATION and then JARVIS_DEFAULT_POSTAL_CODE from the active mode env; it never silently inherits proxy geography. Use serpapi_maps_search instead for map-centered coordinate/radius exploration and serpapi_yelp_search when Yelp-specific ratings, filters, or reviews are requested.

query.description: Required business, place category, or Google-style local query such as coffee, dog-friendly restaurants, or emergency plumber. Do not add a location when the user intends Jarvis's configured default location.

location.description: Optional city-level search origin such as Austin, Texas, United States. When omitted, the active mode's JARVIS_DEFAULT_LOCATION is used, followed by JARVIS_DEFAULT_POSTAL_CODE. Cannot be combined with uule.

uule.description: Advanced Google-encoded location. Cannot be combined with location; coordinate-based values should also supply a matching country.

country.description: Optional two-letter Google country code such as us, uk, or fr.

language.description: Optional two-letter result language such as en, es, or fr.

google_domain.description: Google domain such as google.com or google.co.uk. Default google.com.

place_id.description: Optional Google CID from a prior local result for a focused place search. The query is still required.

tbs.description: Advanced Google Local filter expression for provider-supported filters.

start.description: Result offset for pagination. Use next_start from a prior response. Default 0.

max_results.description: Maximum normalized non-sponsored local results to return. Default 10.

max_ads.description: Maximum sponsored local results to retain separately. Use 0 to omit them. Default 3.

max_discover_more.description: Maximum related Discover More Places searches to retain. Use 0 to omit them. Default 5.

no_cache.description: Bypass SerpApi's one-hour exact-parameter cache. Default false; cached searches are free.

extra_params.description: Advanced non-reserved Google Local parameters passed through to SerpApi. Core query, location, localization, place, filter, device, pagination, cache, and output controls cannot be overridden.

include_raw.description: Include the full SerpApi JSON response for debugging. Default false.

availability.setup_hint: Set SERP_API_KEY in the active mode env file. For location-free prompts, also set JARVIS_DEFAULT_LOCATION or JARVIS_DEFAULT_POSTAL_CODE.
